transcript.answer: `ToolRegistry.execute` in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` (around lines 83-92) catches a tool executor that throws. Issue #138 describes the fix: wrap the executor call and `normalizeToolResponse` in a try/catch. On a throw, `execute` logs the tool name, error name and a message truncated to 500 characters. It then returns a resolved `ToolResponse` with a fixed sentence naming the tool. Before this change, an executor throw rejected `executeToolCalls`'s `Promise.all` and ended the whole conversation with a SERVER_ERROR. This comes from the issue text, which is closed. I did not read the code, so I can't confirm the merged implementation matches it.
sources: issue-138 (re-cinq/Otto): Answer a tool call whose executor threw instead of failing the turn
